name: B10-0124/2026 (ESN) – Post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Uganda's January 2026 election, which President Yoweri Museveni won with 71.65 per cent. It says the campaign was marred by harassment of opposition supporters, internet shutdowns and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine, including calls by the President's son to hunt or kill him. It asks Uganda to protect all political actors, let Bobi Wine return safely, and reform its elections.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Uganda's government, security forces and opposition leaders, especially Bobi Wine.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the EU Council, Commission and Uganda's government. The EU is asked to review its democracy funding to Uganda.
